id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying a customer scoped invalid request error with no detail

review.posthog_relevance: Stripe warehouse ingestion connector error handling and test coverage
review.reason: Adds a standardized, actionable error message ('error_details_unknown') to the Stripe warehouse ingestion connector for cases where Stripe returns a 400-class error without specific details, replacing potentially confusing raw strings. P1.F1.H1 implements this change; P1.F2.H1 adds a corresponding test case. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement in reliability and user
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on supplied hunks; broader context, complete PR, or actual production behavior is unavailable. No evidence of broader systemic impact or unverified outcomes.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are available; no other hunks, PR metadata, or broader context are provided, so this review is limited to these two hunks.

observations.behavior: Adds a new error message key 'error_details_unknown' to the Stripe source's non-retryable error dictionary, accompanied by a comment explaining that Stripe returns a 400-class error with no actionable detail when listing nested customer resources, and that retrying would replay the identical request and fail identically.
observations.code_quote: "error_details_unknown": "Stripe rejected a request for one of your resources without a specific reason. Check your Stripe account for any restrictions or contact Stripe support, then try again.",
observations.posthog_connection: This change improves the Stripe warehouse ingestion connector's error handling. When the connector encounters a Stripe API error lacking a specific detail (e.g., an account restriction or nested resource access failure), it now returns a standardized, actionable message rather than potentially confusing or empty raw error strings. This helps PostHog warehouse users diagnose account

observations.behavior: Adds a corresponding test case entry for the new error message, including a request ID prefix and the 'error_details_unknown' suffix, alongside an existing test for a publishable key error.
observations.posthog_connection: This hunk updates the Stripe warehouse ingestion connector's test suite. It adds a test assertion for the newly implemented error handling behavior, ensuring that the connector correctly identifies and reports the standardized 'error_details_unknown' message. This helps maintain the reliability of the warehouse ingestion workflow and prevents regression in error reporting.
